description: Tutorial lesson T6 (Krumpin'), mouse player path: boot from the tutorial_t6_fight fixture -> the Pile In step is now a REAL move (the Boyz' back rank starts outside 2" engagement range, so only 5 of 10 can swing; End Pile In is refused by the tutorial gate, the player opens the Boyz + Warboss row, Auto Pile In / drags the five back-rank models and Confirms — all 10 can now fight) -> Boyz fight the Custodian Guard (pick a melee weapon + target, Weapon to Target, Fight!, Fast Roll, Done) -> the WARBOSS takes his Fights First swing before the enemy gets one (Decline Epic Challenge, assign, Fight!) -> the Custodian Guard swings back and its hit/wound rolls are revealed step by step in the resolution dock (spectating: 'Show Wound Roll' / 'Show Saving Throws', no Command Re-roll on the enemy's dice) before the player rolls their own saves -> end the phase. The attack dialog, the pile-in dialog and the allocation overlay are embedded modal Windows, so their controls are driven via the emit escape hatch.

steps.script: TutorialManager.active
TutorialManager.current_step_id()

steps.comment: no model base anywhere on the board may overlap another (the Custodian Guard used to sit on a 60px pitch, 3px inside each other's 40mm bases)
5 front-rank Boyz + the Warboss are in real base-to-base contact with the Custodian Guard line

THE PREMISE OF THE STEP: only the five front-rank Boyz are within 2" of the Custodes. The back rank starts 2.3-2.8" off and cannot swing at all until the player pile-ins them in — the fixture used to park them in base contact with the front rank, so the whole mob was already fighting and the Pile In step had nothing to teach.

return RulesEngine.get_eligible_melee_model_indices(b.units["U_WARBOSS_T"], b).size()

the Warboss token is actually drawn - the fixture used to leave the attached character at UNDEPLOYED, so Main._recreate_unit_visuals() skipped it and da boss was invisible on the board
every back-rank Boy is outside engagement range (so cannot fight) but inside 3" of a Custodian (so ONE legal pile-in move fixes it) — the gap the lesson is built around
19.03: bodyguard + attached character pile in as one entry, and the lesson's prompt names that row
the step no longer allows END_PILE_IN — skipping the pile-in would leave half the mob unable to swing, so the tutorial gate refuses it and toasts the blocked_hint

THE PAYOFF: the pile-in the player just made brought the back rank into engagement range, so the whole mob swings. Everything downstream (the Power klaw / choppa split, the Custodes surviving to swing back) depends on this.

THE REPORTED BUG: the enemy's swing back used to resolve hits AND wounds in one shot and hand the player a finished 'N wounds to save' prompt. It now rolls out in the dock the player's own attacks use — spectating, 'Show Wound Roll' rather than 'Roll to Wound' (they are not the player's dice to roll), and no Command Re-roll offered on them.
